items.content_text: ee.schimke.composeai:appwidget-preview-runtime 0.19.46 发布, Composable helper that inflates a `RemoteViews` factory into the surrounding Compose `@Preview` tree and auto-discovers `<appwidget-provider>` metadata via `AppWidgetManager.installedProviders` — the composable-helper authoring path for legacy `RemoteViews`-backed App Widget previews. Sister to `notification-preview-runtime` and `glance-preview-runtime`.
